title: Sending limits — per day and month
summary: This document explains sending limits for new vs. verified accounts: New accounts have $750/day and $7,500/month; verified accounts have $3,500/day and $35,000/month. A send must fit within both remaining daily and monthly caps, and hitting either cap blocks further sends for the remainder of that day/month.
